The poster features a stylized, artistic representation of the Imola circuit, emphasizing its challenging and colorful layout. Track Design: The track is depicted with bold, curved lines in red, white, yellow, and green, representing the Italian flag colors. The names of key turns on the track are labeled: "Piratella," "Variante Villeneuve," and "Tamburel
